```{python}
import os
import sys
import json
from pathlib import Path
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import scanpy as sc
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns

pd.set_option("display.max_columns", None)
pd.set_option("display.max_rows", None)
pd.set_option("display.max_colwidth", None)
pd.set_option("display.width", 1000)

HERE = Path(os.getcwd())
if str(HERE) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))

import onboarding_utils as ou
from dataset_specs import get_dataset_spec

DATA_ROOT = Path('/Volumes/Shared/DataCollections/Standardized_SingleCell_Datasets/JooM_2025_41097818/output')
NAME = 'Myocardial_infarction'
SPEC = get_dataset_spec(NAME)
NAS_FILE = str(DATA_ROOT / SPEC["file_name"])
EXPECTED = {
    "cells": SPEC["expected_source"]["cells"],
    "samples": SPEC["expected_source"]["independent_units"],
    "ct_types": None,
}
SAMPLE_CANDIDATES = list(SPEC["sample_candidates"])
SAMPLE_STABLE_COLS = list(SPEC["sample_stable_cols"])
ECODA_SECONDARY_BIO = [c for c in SAMPLE_STABLE_COLS if c != SPEC["bio_col"]]
BIO_COL = SPEC["bio_col"]
BATCH_COLS = list(SPEC["batch_cols"])
ALL_CT_COLS = list(SPEC["cell_type_candidates"])

ds_data = ou.load_onboarding_dataset_or_subset(NAME, NAS_FILE, HERE)
mode = ds_data["mode"]
sub = ds_data["sub"]
adata = ds_data["adata"]
meta_info = ds_data["meta"] or {}

if mode == "nas" and SPEC.get("subset_vars"):
    subset_mask = pd.Series(True, index=adata.obs_names)
    for subset_col, subset_rule in SPEC["subset_vars"].items():
        if subset_col not in adata.obs.columns:
            raise KeyError(f"{NAME}: subset_vars references missing obs column {subset_col!r}")
        values = subset_rule.get("values", [])
        col_mask = adata.obs[subset_col].isin(values)
        subset_mask &= col_mask if subset_rule.get("op", "in") == "in" else ~col_mask
    adata = adata[subset_mask]

if mode == "nas":
    sample_audit_df, sample_selection = ou.audit_sample_candidates(
        adata.obs,
        SAMPLE_CANDIDATES,
        SAMPLE_STABLE_COLS,
        SPEC["expected_source"]["independent_units"],
    )
    ct_sample = SPEC["registry_roles"]["sample"] if SPEC["registry_roles"]["sample"] in adata.obs.columns else (sample_selection.get("selected") or SAMPLE_CANDIDATES[0])
    ct_column_audit_df, ct_label_audit_df, ct_selection = ou.audit_cell_type_candidates(
        adata.obs, ALL_CT_COLS, ct_sample, BIO_COL, BATCH_COLS
    )
    registry_gate = ou.build_registry_gate(
        SPEC,
        adata.obs,
        sample_audit_df,
        sample_selection,
        ct_column_audit_df,
        ct_label_audit_df,
        ct_selection,
    )
else:
    sample_payload = meta_info.get("sample_audit", {})
    sample_audit_df = pd.DataFrame(sample_payload.get("candidates", []))
    sample_selection = sample_payload.get("selection", {})
    ct_column_audit_df = pd.DataFrame(meta_info.get("cell_type_column_audit", []))
    ct_label_audit_df = pd.DataFrame(meta_info.get("cell_type_label_audit", []))
    ct_selection = meta_info.get("cell_type_selection", {})
    registry_gate = meta_info.get("registry_gate", {"status": "MISSING", "reasons": ["registry_gate missing"]})

selected = registry_gate.get("selected") or {}
SAMPLE_COL = selected.get("sample") or SAMPLE_CANDIDATES[0]
REGISTRY_CT_COL = selected.get("cell_type_high_res") or selected.get("cell_type_low_res") or ALL_CT_COLS[0]
role_obs = adata.obs if mode == "nas" else sub.obs
CT_COL = REGISTRY_CT_COL if REGISTRY_CT_COL in role_obs.columns else next((c for c in ALL_CT_COLS if c in role_obs.columns), REGISTRY_CT_COL)
diagnostic_batch_cols = [c for c in BATCH_COLS if role_obs.get(c) is not None]

if mode == "nas" or sub is None:
    if registry_gate.get("status") not in {"PASS", "PASS_PENDING_DERIVED_ANNOTATION"}:
        raise RuntimeError(f"{NAME}: cannot create a diagnostic subset without a passing declared-role gate")
    sub, _ = ou.subset_by_samples(
        adata,
        sample_col=SAMPLE_COL,
        bio_col=BIO_COL,
        batch_cols=diagnostic_batch_cols,
        ct_col=CT_COL,
    )

```

## 1. Study Summary & Metadata Categorization

> **Myocardial Infarction (MI-2)** -- Kuppe et al. 2022, *Nature* 608(7924):766-777, PMID 35948637. Spatial and single-cell atlas of human myocardial infarction: 132,888 single cells across 23 samples (from 19 patients) covering distinct disease stages (`patient_group`: `Control`, `Myogenic`, `Fibrotic`, `Ischemic`) and two distinct library batches (`batch`: `A` vs `B`).

### Metadata Collinearity Matrix (Normalized Mutual Information)

> **Collinearity Diagnostic:** Quantifies pairwise non-linear association among all biological and technical covariates at the sample level using Normalized Mutual Information (NMI $\in [0, 1]$). Values $> 0.70$ indicate severe collinearity and confounding.

```{python}
all_cand_cols = list(dict.fromkeys([BIO_COL] + ECODA_SECONDARY_BIO + BATCH_COLS))
nmi_mat = ou.compute_metadata_nmi_matrix(sub.obs, SAMPLE_COL, all_cand_cols)
fig_nmi = ou.plot_metadata_nmi_heatmap(nmi_mat, title=f"Metadata Collinearity Matrix (NMI) — {NAME}")
plt.figure(fig_nmi.number)
plt.show()
```

## 4. Unintegrated Embeddings (Fresh PCA + UMAP)

> **Embedding Protocol:** Computed directly from processed raw counts (total counts normalized to 10k, log1p, 2000 HVGs via Seurat v3 paper flavor, scaled PCA 50 PCs, standard Scanpy UMAP with `min_dist=0.5, spread=1.0`). **No pre-existing or batch-corrected embeddings are used.**

```{python}
label_cols = [c for c in [SAMPLE_COL, BIO_COL] + BATCH_COLS + [CT_COL] if c and c in sub.obs.columns]
um = ou.embed_and_umap_workflow(
    sub, label_cols=label_cols, out_dir=None, name=NAME,
    sample_col=SAMPLE_COL,
)
sub_embedded = um["subset"]

for fig in um["figs"]:
    plt.figure(fig.number)
    plt.show()
```

## 5. Variance Partition & Distance PERMANOVA Across Covariates

> **Variance Partitioning Protocol:**
> 1. **Cell-Type Specific Variance Partitioning:** Quantifies the fraction of inter-sample variance in cell-type abundance explained by each biological vs. technical covariate across cell types and whole cohort average (`Whole atlas`), following Sikkema et al. 2023 (*Nature Medicine* 29:1563–1577, Fig. 4a).
> 2. **Global Distance PERMANOVA & Variance Decomposition:** Partitions total inter-sample Aitchison distance variance (Euclidean distance on CLR composition) into **Unique Biological**, **Unique Technical**, **Shared/Confounded**, and **Residual** variance via multi-variable marginal PERMANOVA with permutation tests (Anderson 2001).

```{python}
bio_candidates = list(dict.fromkeys([c for c in [BIO_COL] + ECODA_SECONDARY_BIO if c in sub.obs.columns]))
tech_candidates = list(dict.fromkeys([c for c in BATCH_COLS if c in sub.obs.columns]))

for annot_col in ALL_CT_COLS:
    if annot_col not in sub.obs.columns:
        continue
    clr_curr = ou.compute_clr_composition(sub.obs, SAMPLE_COL, annot_col)
    
    # 1. Feature-level variance partition heatmap (Sikkema et al.)
    var_tech, var_bio = ou.compute_variance_partition(
        clr_curr, sub.obs, SAMPLE_COL, bio_candidates, tech_candidates
    )
    
    fig_var = ou.plot_variance_partition_heatmap(
        var_tech, var_bio,
        title=f"Fraction of Total Variance Explained Across Covariates — {annot_col}"
    )
    plt.figure(fig_var.number)
    plt.show()

    # 2. Global Distance PERMANOVA & Variance Decomposition
    univar_perm, joint_perm, stats_text = ou.compute_compositional_permanova(
        clr_curr, sub.obs, SAMPLE_COL, bio_candidates, tech_candidates, n_permutations=999
    )
    
    fig_perm = ou.plot_compositional_permanova(
        univar_perm, joint_perm,
        title=f"Compositional Distance Variance Decomposition (PERMANOVA) — {annot_col}"
    )
    plt.figure(fig_perm.number)
    plt.show()

    print(stats_text)
```
